title: Xihuang pill suppressed primary liver cancer growth by downregulation of AFP and YAP signaling.
authors: Luo, Sha; Huang, Zhen; Dai, Yuewen; Wang, Shuyang; Yu, Wantao; Li, Zhihan; Pu, Qing; Yang, Lihui; Yang, Tianyi; Tang, Yu; Wang, Zhang; Wang, Jiabo; Wang, Jingxiao
one_liner_zh: 研究中药西黄丸通过下调AFP和YAP信号抑制肝癌生长，虽含分子对接但对象为蛋白-蛋白/小分子，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Xihuang Pill (XHP) is a traditional Chinese medicine formula that was originally used to treat malignant ulcers. Recent studies revealed its therapeutic effects on various malignant tumors. However, its potential efficacy and mechanisms in primary liver cancer (PLC) were not thoroughly investigated. AIM OF THE STUDY: This study aimed to elucidate the efficacy and potential mechanisms of XHP in the treatment of PLC. METHODS: An orthotopic PLC mice model was established adopting hydrodynamic tail vein injection method. Human liver cancer cell lines and organoids were utilized to assess the effect of XHP in vitro. The expressions of alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) and Yes-associated protein (YAP) were evaluated with western blotting. The mRNA expressions of YAP downstream targets were detected with qRT-PCR. Data from Liver Hepatocellular Carcinoma Collection of the Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA-LIHC) were extracted to identify the potential targets of HCC. The major active components of XHP methanol extract and XHP medicated serum were detected by UHPLC-MS/MS. Human liver cancer cell lines were used to assess the efficacy and potential mechanisms of these active components in XHP in vitro. Finally, molecular docking was conducted to predict the binding affinities of XHP's active components with AFP and YAP. RESULTS: XHP inhibited PLC tumor growth in the mice model with decreased AFP and Ki-67 index. In vitro, XHP suppressed the proliferation and migration of liver cancer cell lines in a time- and dose-dependent manner. Furthermore, even with a low concentration (5 mg/mL), XHP paralyzed the growth of PLC organoids derived from patients. Mechanistically, XHP downregulated the expression of AFP and YAP signaling in vitro and in vivo. UHPLC-MS/MS analysis identified 25 active components in XHP medicated serum. Among them, certain active compounds suppressed PLC cell proliferation and downregulated AFP and YAP signaling, suggesting their therapeutic potentials in PLC. Molecular docking indicated that several components in XHP exhibited strong binding affinities with both AFP and YAP. CONCLUSION: XHP inhibited PLC growth by suppressing AFP and YAP signaling. This study provides an experimental basis for XHP application in PLC treatment.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：西黄丸（XHP）是一种传统中药方剂，最初用于治疗恶性溃疡。近期研究揭示了其对多种恶性肿瘤的治疗效果。然而，其在原发性肝癌（PLC）中的潜在疗效和机制尚未得到深入研究。研究目的：本研究旨在阐明XHP治疗PLC的疗效及潜在机制。方法：采用流体力学尾静脉注射方法建立原位PLC小鼠模型。利用人肝癌细胞系和类器官评估XHP的体外效果。通过蛋白质印迹法评估甲胎蛋白（AFP）和Yes相关蛋白（YAP）的表达。通过qRT-PCR检测YAP下游靶标的mRNA表达。提取癌症基因组图谱肝细胞癌数据集（TCGA-LIHC）的数据以识别肝细胞癌（HCC）的潜在靶点。通过UHPLC-MS/MS检测XHP甲醇提取物和XHP含药血清的主要活性成分。使用人肝癌细胞系评估这些活性成分在XHP中的体外疗效和潜在机制。最后，进行分子对接以预测XHP活性成分与AFP和YAP的结合亲和力。结果：XHP在小鼠模型中抑制了PLC肿瘤生长，并降低了AFP和Ki-67指数。体外实验显示，XHP以时间和剂量依赖性方式抑制肝癌细胞系的增殖和迁移。此外，即使在低浓度（5 mg/mL）下，XHP也能抑制患者来源的PLC类器官的生长。机制上，XHP在体外和体内均下调了AFP和YAP信号通路的表达。UHPLC-MS/MS分析在XHP含药血清中鉴定出25种活性成分。其中，某些活性化合物抑制了PLC细胞增殖并下调了AFP和YAP信号通路，表明其在PLC中的治疗潜力。分子对接显示，XHP中的多种成分与AFP和YAP均表现出强结合亲和力。结论：XHP通过抑制AFP和YAP信号通路抑制PLC生长。本研究为XHP在PLC治疗中的应用提供了实验依据。
